body.x: Macally(www.macally.com), a manufacturer and distributor of sleek accessories for computers and mobile devices with a specialization in accessories for Apple, introduced DOCK15, a secure storage cabinet which can store, charge, and sync up to 15 tablets simultaneously, at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

DOCK15 is an iPad and Tablet Sync/Charge Docking Cabinet with Lock made of heavy gauge steel with two doors to allow for front door access to insert and remove iPads and tablets and a rear door access to organize power supply and cable management. It connects via Lightning, 30-pin or Micro USB cables. iPad and Android tablets are auto detected and will quickly charge simultaneously. 2.1A outputs with numbered slots to keep devices organized and LED lights to indicate when the device is 100% charged.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.

Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.
